unlisted_practices: LLM-guided evolutionary code search to synthesize inspectable hospital payment/mechanism rule programs
Evaluating healthcare mechanisms by equilibrium under strategic provider response (coding, selection, delay, effort, triage) in multi-agent simulation
Mixed-objective mechanism design to reduce up-coding and patient rejection
Audit levers on a single provider channel and testing for pressure migration to other channels

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an LLM-guided program synthesis and multi-agent simulation framework (Medi-Sim) for healthcare policy/mechanism design, simulating strategic provider behaviors.
